name: Athena Amelia Aetos
source:
Roomate to Heidi and Jackson.

Likes the Goth style

An avid gamer and motorcycle rider.

Works as a bartender.

Has a tough personality but can be loving with those she trust.

Paints her hair black but is naturally a blonde.

Cousin to Adrian from Come Home.
